'''Siric''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] native of his planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], which was occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. An assistant to the explosives expert [[Cuvran]], Siric assisted [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] when she [[Heurkea operation|traveled to Dac]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] to recruit [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] to the Rebel Alliance and orchestrate sabotage against the Empire on the planet.<ref name="TFU2" />
